description: This file defines a class 'NodePairingApprovalPrompter' responsible for managing node pairing requests, including presenting prompts to users, handling approvals or rejections, synchronizing state with external sources, and performing silent approval attempts. It also includes related data structures, enum policies, and helper methods for network and system interactions.

classes.name: NodePairingReconcilePolicy
classes.description: Defines polling and delay policy constants and a method to determine if polling should occur.

classes.name: NodePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle and user interaction for node pairing approval requests, including presenting dialogs, handling responses, automatic approval, synchronization, and notification.

classes.name: PairingList
classes.description: Data structure representing the list of pending and paired nodes.

classes.name: PairedNode
classes.description: Represents a node that is paired, including its identification and metadata.

classes.name: PendingRequest
classes.description: Represents a pairing request that is pending approval, including metadata and state.

classes.name: SSHTarget
classes.description: Represents SSH connection target details used in silent approval attempts.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the prompter's push task handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing tasks and clears internal state.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches pending pairing requests from the gateway with retries.

methods.name: reconcileLoop
methods.description: Continuously reconciles requests to keep state in sync.

methods.name: fetchPairingList
methods.description: Fetches current pairing list from the gateway with a specified timeout.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Processes a new pairing list, updates request state, and manages dialogs.

methods.name: inferResolution
methods.description: Infers whether a request has been approved or rejected based on pairing list.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the current active pairing alert dialog.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push events related to pairing requests or resolutions.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a pairing request to the queue and triggers presentation.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Presents the next pairing request prompt if not already presenting.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays a user prompt for a pairing request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Handles user response to pairing prompts, including approval or rejection.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends approval for a pairing request to the gateway.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects a pairing request via the gateway.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides a descriptive string for a pairing request for UI display.

methods.name: prettyIP
methods.description: Formats an IP address string for display.

methods.name: prettyPlatform
methods.description: Formats a platform string for display.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a local notification regarding pairing resolution.

methods.name: trySilentApproveIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts silent approval of a pairing request via SSH or network.

methods.name: resolveSSHTarget
methods.description: Determines SSH target details for silent approval.

methods.name: probeSSH
methods.description: Performs an SSH connection attempt to verify reachability.

methods.name: updateReconcileLoop
methods.description: Manages the lifecycle of the reconcile background task based on current state.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates quick-access counts for UI display.

methods.name: reconcileOnce
methods.description: Performs a single reconciliation operation.

methods.name: scheduleReconcileOnce
methods.description: Schedules a one-time reconciliation after delay.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Processes resolution notifications from external sources.
